title: Practice 2: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Everyone get out of the twilight!
exercises.why: **выйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: **влетела** — past tense (feminine) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: We'll put you on the list.
exercises.why: **внесем** — future tense (1st person plural) of внести: perfective (imperfective partner: вносить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
